citations.quote: At least now I know. At least now I can fix it. At least now I can build it properly.

observation.text: The author uses a series of 'At least now' statements to express gratitude for understanding their errors and having the opportunity to fix them: 'At least now I know. At least now I can fix it. At least now I can build it properly.'

citations.quote: Realising you’ve been building something the wrong way for two years is probably a pretty normal Founder experience.

summary.text: The author realized they had been building their YouTube channel the wrong way for two years after their monthly subscribers decreased by 50%, and views were at their lowest.

knowledge.title: Realizing a Mistake in YouTube Channel Strategy

summary.text: The author decided to invest in group coaching by an industry expert to become a YouTube Producer to fix the issues with their channel.
